$comment: Candidate research sources. ALL DISABLED until the owner reads each source's terms and robots.txt and sets terms_checked: true (then enabled: true). The agent refuses to load a source that is enabled without terms_checked. Only type 'autocomplete' is allowed; forums and page scraping are not supported. The agent also checks robots.txt itself, identifies as 'ChangeLensResearchBot (+https://tools.changelense.in)', and makes at most 50 requests per weekly run.

sources.name: Google search suggestions (unofficial endpoint)
sources.notes: Undocumented endpoint. Google's terms restrict automated access to its services; owner must confirm this use is permitted before enabling.

sources.name: YouTube search suggestions (unofficial endpoint)
sources.notes: Same endpoint and caveats as google-suggest; shows what agents search for as videos.

sources.name: DuckDuckGo autocomplete
sources.notes: Undocumented endpoint; check the terms and robots.txt before enabling.

sources.name: Wikipedia OpenSearch API (English)
sources.notes: Documented public API (MediaWiki API etiquette: identify with a user-agent, be gentle). Weak commercial-intent signal; mostly useful for Hindi/English term coverage.
